integrity.literature_boundary: Douglas reduced-solution uniqueness is prior operator theory; the finding distinguishes it from the source theorem's stronger and false norm-only uniqueness statement.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact operator inequalities, a one-dimensional reciprocal counterexample, and a two-dimensional exact family of minimum-norm dual frames.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification is asserted for all K-g-frames whose norm-minimizing K-dual is unique.

scientific_limitations: The nonuniqueness claim concerns minimization by synthesis-operator norm alone; the Douglas reduced solution remains unique under its standard reduced-range normalization.
No claim is made that every canonical K-dual construction in the later literature is invalid.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same source-specific observation.
title: The canonical \(K\)-dual norm theorem has a reciprocal constant and nonunique minimizers
